title: Represent and display parser items
description: An item is a grammar production with a dot marking progress through its right-hand side. You represent it with a production index and a dot position.

steps.description: PRODUCTIONS stores each left-hand symbol and its right-hand sequence. The two sets classify grammar symbols.
show_item uses the item's production index to retrieve that production.
The slices place a dot at the item's position. Joining those symbols gives you a readable item for later checkpoints.
